title: Atlas 1.1 — Reviewer Pipeline
description: Machine-readable ledger of PROTOCOL.md section 9 external review requests. Hand-maintained: one entry per real request actually sent. Never backfilled.

evidence_ids.description: the bounded set of evidence-registry.json items sent — a request must be scoped, never 'the whole registry'

question.description: the precise, bounded question asked, per PROTOCOL.md section 9

package_hash.description: SHA-256 of the exact package sent

conflicts_declared.description: conflicts of interest disclosed, or explicit 'none declared'

authorization_ref.description: required before any contract, exclusivity, IP assignment or payment term proceeds, per PROTOCOL.md section 9 — points to the founder's explicit authorization record
